title: Lewenskwaliteit te midde van ‘n erge stressor: ‘n studie van bejaardes met alzheimer se siekte of rumatoïede artritis
journal: Health SA Gesondheid: Journal of Interdisciplinary Health Sciences

sections.abstract: This study addresses the role of psychofortigenic factors in maintaining quality of life in elderly people diagnosed with either rheumatoid arthritis or Alzheimer's disease. Opsomming Hierdie studie handel oor die rol wat psigofortigene faktore speel in die handhawing van lewenskwaliteit deur bejaardes wat gediagnoseer is met rumatoïede artritis of Alzheimer se siekte. *Please note: This is a reduced version of the abstract. Please refer to PDF for full text.
